key_risks: High capital intensity and long gestation periods (4-5 years construction, 25+ years operation)
Macroeconomic factors: economic growth, interest rates, political/economic environment
Transition from regulated to competitive regime increasing cost consciousness
Dependence on domestic market (Gujarat) for entire revenue
Adverse changes in government policies, regulations, taxes, or removal of incentives
Gas-based generation unviable; Vadodara gas stations non-operational
High debt financing required for proposed capacity addition; need for increased bank/insurance exposure limits
AT&C losses of state utilities affecting their ability to pay
Ageing thermal assets and deteriorating lignite quality requiring R&M
